item.title: Edwards and Reid combine for 62, Timberwolves win 125-115 to snap Heat’s 4-game winning streak
item.description: MIAMI (AP) — Anthony Edwards scored 33 points, Naz Reid had 20 of his 29 in the second half and the Minnesota Timberwolves pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat Miami 125-115 on Saturday night and snap the Heat’s four-game winning streak.
